user.title: Connect to Lefant M1
user.description: Enter your Lefant M1 connection details. The robot speaks Tuya LAN protocol 3.3 (measured on hardware); 3.4/3.5 are available for other Lefant models. The Local Key is a per-device credential that no cloud wizard returns for a robot paired with the Lefant app: use the extraction guide in the README (Frida hook on the app's SDK object, no rooted phone needed). This integration does not extract it. Keep the key private.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the robot on TCP port 6668. Verify the IP address and make sure the robot is powered on and connected to Wi-Fi.
error.invalid_auth: Local Key rejected, or the protocol version is wrong for this robot. The M1 answers 3.3.
error.unknown: Unexpected error occurred during connection test.

abort.already_configured: This Lefant M1 robot vacuum is already configured.
